decision_record.calculation: Fixture: close 120 vs level 101 (premium 19.0), ATR 3.357 -> stop distance 6.71; premium = 2.83x the stop distance -> refused. Ordinary breakout fixture (close 105, premium 4.0 < 4.71) enters under both rules.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: any close above the 20-day high enters, however far it ran. The sleeve's crypto twin got this exact refusal in its first Edge pass (ENH-DONCHIAN-CRYPTO); the equity twin never did.
decision_record.experiment: Adapters3 A/B on identical bars: ON refuses the chase fixture, OFF enters it; the ordinary-breakout fixture enters under both (no over-refusal).
decision_record.mechanism: Execution timing / chase refusal, with the twin's own yardstick: refuse when close - level > ATR_MULT (2.0) x ATR(14), recomputed at the adapter layer from the served bars and the intent's price_hint (the breakout close).
decision_record.transfer: The breakout edge is paid for entering NEAR the channel level, where the coded stop (2xATR) is ~1R away. A close that has already run several R past the level buys the same stop distance at a far worse basis.

switch: extra.donchian_enh2.chase_gate default ON; OFF restores the pre-change entry rule exactly
